name: Adaptive Multi-Step Empty Voxel Skipping
definition: An acceleration technique for volume rendering that combines empty voxel skipping (space leaping) with adaptive multi-step length sampling to reduce redundant computation on empty regions while maintaining image quality.
summary: Adaptive Multi-Step Empty Voxel Skipping accelerates volume rendering by dynamically adjusting ray step sizes to bypass empty regions, reducing computation without altering input data.
